description: This file defines a React context and provider for authentication management using Supabase. It includes hooks for accessing auth state, user profile, roles, and authentication actions such as sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, and token retrieval. The code manages session state, subscribes to auth changes, and fetches user profile data from a backend API.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication context to its children, managing session, user, profile, and role states, and exposing authentication actions.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Hook to access the authentication context, providing user info, session, profile, role, and auth actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Alias for useSupabaseAuth, for consumers expecting useAuth.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to retrieve the current user's role ('trainer', 'member', 'admin') or null.
